generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: Schema-complete attack evidence can remain non-discriminating when validators check only field presence or text length instead of concrete semantic specificity.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Fill every adversarial evidence field with generic test prose that passes minimum-length checks but names no mechanism, boundary, procedure, or observable outcome.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Reject adversarial evidence metadata that lacks multiple non-generic mechanism terms and a concrete multi-word procedure and outcome.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Before spending an independent audit, independently reject generic requirement attacks or generic failure, procedure, expected, and observed evidence fields.
